**Evidence resolution (Section B)**

Resolved check set: all checks on `9c1e4f2` (no `ci checks:` config). `test_unit` success, `build_image` success, `lint` skipped (inert). Zero blocking conclusions, zero pending; `actions_runs` 7001 is completed/success, so no held run; no opt-out. Top-down: Opt-out no, Failed CI no, Held run no, Pending no -> **CI-sufficient**. No local run; evidence is the CI claim (`test_unit`, `build_image`, success, `9c1e4f2`, run 7001). Claims (claim-check-only): "adds one bounded retry" matched against `src/feed/client.ts`; "tests cover the retry path" matched at `test/feed/client.test.ts:12-40`. No ticket (digest `issue: null`; the title's `TW-88` token was not resolved by the Gatherer, so no AC rows). Reviewer SHIP with no findings: no blockers, no nits, no comments. `merge_state_status: BLOCKED` with `reviewDecision: REVIEW_REQUIRED` means the forge would refuse `merge` under branch protection, so that row is omitted and named; the viewer is not the author, so `approve` is available and recommended.

```
Delivers: the tide-feed client retries once on a 503 instead of failing the fetch outright.

Verdict: mergeable - CI green on the assessed head (test_unit, build_image)

1. approve - approve the PR                                               [recommended]
2. fix - name the change to apply in the worktree, review the wave, push
3. show evidence - gate output, CI run
4. stop - leave the PR as-is
Type a number. Not offered: merge (branch protection: review required).
```

rationale.anthropic/claude-opus-5-5: CI-sufficient on 9c1e4f2 is stated, and merge is withheld with BLOCKED cited in the prose. There is no wait row and no PR comments line, and the block is attributed to a branch-protection review rule. The report is cluttered with raw field names, run IDs and passing checks.
rationale.github-copilot/gpt-6-astra: CI resolves green and merge is omitted as blocked, but wait and the required PR comments line are missing; the text attributes the block to branch protection and prints internal IDs and passing checks.
